spans.s:
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Distant, removed, remote.
2 Best, preeminent.
3 Subsequent, after, following.
4 Other, different.
5 Inimical, hostile, estranged, adverse.
6 Addicted to, attached to, engaged in.
7 More, exceeding, as परंशतं more than a hundred, परो लक्षः more than a Lac: these are also considered as distinct compounds, see the next.
m. (-रः)
1 An enemy.
2 The life of BRAHMĀ.
n. ind. (-रं)
1 Only, alone.
2 After, afterwards.
subst.
1 Final beatitude.
2 (In Logic,) One species of common property, that which comprehends many objects, genus; or it is the same with existence, as the common property of all things.
E.
पॄ to fill, &c. aff. अप्.

ind.
A participle and prefix implying,
1

Supremacy.
2

Liberation.
3

Inverted order.
4 Pride, contumely.
5 Encounter, mutual presence.
6 Excess, exceeding.
7 Overcoming, surpassing.
8

Going.
9

Killing, destroying, injuring.
As पराक्रम superior power or valour; पराजय defeat; पराभव disgrace; परावर्त turning back, &c. see the following.
E.
पॄ to fill, aff. अप् and आ added.

r. 10th cl. (पारयति)
To accomplish, to finish, to get through or over.

n. (-रं)
The further or opposite bank of a river.
mn. (-रः-रं)
The end, the extremity, the last.
m. (-रः)
Quicksilver.
f. (-रा)
The name of a river, said to flow from the Pāriyātra mountains, or the centrical and western portion of the Vindhya chain.
f. (-री)
1 A quantity of water.
2 A rope for tying an elephant's feet.
3 A small water jar.
4 The pollen of a flower.
5 A drinking vessel, a glass, a cup.
6 A milk pail.
E.
पर another, ईर to go to or towards; or पार to cross over; or पॄ to fill, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
More than a hundred, many.
E.
पर more, and शत a hundred: see the last.

mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं)
More than a thousand.
E.
पर more, and सहस्र a thousand: see पर.

ind. (-स्वः)
The day after to-morrow.
E.
पर after, स्वस् tomorrow.

n. (-त्रं)
Another's wife.
E.
पर, and कलत्र a wife.

n. (-नं)
Intriguing with another man's wife. adultery.
E.
परकलत्र another's wife, अभिगमन approaching.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Another, belonging to another.
f. (-या)
The mistress or wife of another, one of the three objects of love, according to the Śṛṅgāra or amatory doctrine.
E.
पर another, छ aff., कुक् augment.

n. (-त्रं)
1 Another man's wife.
2 Another's body.
3 Another's field.
E.
पर another, क्षेच a field.

m. (-न्थिः)
An articulation, a joint.
E.
पर after, ग्रन्थि a joining.

f. (-निः)
Reduction or subjugation of an enemy.
E.
पर, and ग्लानि vexing.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
Dependant, subservient, subjected.
E.
पर another, छन्द inclination.

n. (-द्रं)
A fault or defect in another.
E.
पर, and छिद्र flaw.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Adopted, fostered, nourished by a stranger.
2 Dependant, servile, subjected.
E.
पर another, and जात born.

mfn. (तः-ता-तं)
1 Nourished by a stranger.
2 Conquered, subdued.
E.
पर another, and जित conquered, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Conquered, defeated, overcome.
2 Won at dice, &c.
E.
परा encounter, and जित conquered.

m. (-ञ्जः)
1 An oil press.
2 Froth, foam.
3 The blade of a sword or a knife.
4 A sword or scymitar.
f. (-ञ्जा)
The sound of instruments at a festival.
n. (-ञ्जं)
The sword of INDRA.
E.
पर in the second case, another, and जि to conquer, aff. ड; some works have परज, and others पराञ्ज in place of this word.

m. (-ञ्जः)
1 An oil mill.
2 Froth or foam.
3 The blade of a sword or knife: see परञ्ज.

m. (-नः)
A name of VARUṆA, the regent of water.
E.
पर another, जि to conquer, deriv. irr.; also परञ्जय.

m. (-यः)
VARUṆA: see the last.

mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं)
Subservient, obedient, dependant.
E.
पर another, तन्त्र will.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Greatest.
E.
पर, and तमप् aff. of the superlative.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Greater, more.
E.
पर more, and तरप् aff.

ind.
1

Afterwards.
2

Behind.
3

Otherwise, differently.
E.
पर or परा, and अतसुच् aff.

ind.
The next world, futurity.
E.
पर another, त्रल् aff.

m. (-रुः)
A pious man, one standing in awe of futurity.
E.
परच the next world, and भीरु timid.

m. (-त्वं)
1 Difference, distinction, separateness.
2

Hostility.
3

(In Logic,) Priority of place or time, proximity, juvenility.
4 The nature of common or generic property.
E.
त्व added to पर; also with तल, परता.

m. (-रः)
Another's wife.
E.
पर, and दार a wife.

n. (-नं)
Adultery, adulterous intercourse or intrigue.
E.
परदार, and गमन frequenting.

m. (-र्षः)
Intriguing with another man's wife.
E.
परदार, and अभिमर्ष contact.

n. (-नं)
Intriguing with another's wife.
E.
परदार, and उपसेवन frequenting; also परदारोपसेवा.

n. (-खं)
The pain or sorrow of another.
E.
पर, and दुःख pain.

m. (-शः)
A foreign country.
E.
पर, and देश place.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Foreign, exotic.
m. (-शी)
1 A foreigner.
2 One residing abroad.
E.
परदेश, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Living abroad, travelling, a traveller.
E.
परदेश, and सेविन् who frequents.

n. (-नं)
Scandal, calumny, censoriousness.
E.
पर, दोष fault, कीर्त्तन proclaiming.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Hostile, inimical, adverse.
E.
पर another, द्विष to hate, घिणुन् aff.

n. (-व्यं)
Another's property.
E.
पर, and द्रव्य thing.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Tyrannising over another.
E.
पर, and द्रोहिन् injurious.

n. (-नं)
Another's wealth.
E.
पर, and धन wealth.

n. (-खं)
Feeding luxuriously at another's expense.
E.
परधन, आस्वादन eating, सुख pleasure.

m. (-र्म्मः)
Another's duty or business, the occupation of another caste.
E.
पर, and धर्म्म duty.

n. (-नं)
Intent absorption or abstraction in the subject of meditation.
E.
पर, and ध्यान meditating.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Vexing or annoying another, subduing a foe.
m. (-पः)
A conqueror.
E.
पर another, तप to heat or inflame, aff. खच्.

n. (-दं)
1 Eminence, high station.
2 Final felicity.
E.
पर supreme, पद place.

m. (-हः)
The family or dependants of another.
E.
पर, and परिग्रह dependants.

m. (-कः)
What is dressed or cooked by another, another's food.
E.
पर, and पाक cooking.

m. (-त्तः)
One who dresses his own food without observing, the expiatory sacrifice for the five Sūnas, or places of destruction to animal life: see पञ्चसूना.
E.
पर another, पाक cooking, and निवृत्त ceased.

m. (-तः)
One who observes all the due ceremonies preparatory to cooking, but lives upon others.
E.
पर another, पाक cooking, रत constant.

m. (-चिः)
A constant guest at otherś tables.
E.
पर anothers, पाक cooking, and रुचि shining.

n. (-ण्डं)
Food given by another.
E.
पर, and पिण्ड ball of rice or meat.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Feeding at another's cost.
E.
पर पिण्ड, and आद who takes.

m. (-षः)
1 A name of VIṢṆ

Another man.
E.
पर supreme, and पुरुष man.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Fostered, nourished, &c. by a stranger.
m. (-ष्टः)
The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
f. (-ष्टा)
A harlot, a whore.
2 A parasite plant.
E.
पर another, पुष्ट cherished.

m. (-वः)
The mango.
E.
परपुष्ट the cuckoo, महा great, and उत्सव festival.

f. (-र्व्वा)
A woman, formerly married.
E.
पर another, (husband,) पूर्व्व prior, fem. aff. टाप्.

m. (-तिः)
The husband of a woman remarried.
E.
परपूर्व्वा, and पति a husband.

m. (-प्ता)
A great-great-grandson.
E.
पर subsequent, प्रति after, नप्तृ a grandson.

m. (-चः)
A great-great-grandson.
E.
पर subsequent, प्रपौत्र great-grandson.

n. (-त्वं)
Servitude, slavery.
E.
पर, and प्रेष्यत्व service.

n. (-ह्म)
The Supreme Being.
E.
पर, and ब्रह्म the same.

m. (-गः)
1 Excellence, superior merit, supremacy.
2 Good fortune, prosperity.
3 The last part, residue, remainder.
E.
पर best, भाग portion.

n. (-ग्यं)
Another's wealth or prosperity.
E.
पर, and भाग्य good fortune.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Possessed or enjoyed by another.
E.
पर, and भुक्त enjoyed.

f. (-मिः)
A foreign or an enemy's country.
E.
पर, and भूमि land.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Living or being in a foreign or an enemy's country.
E.
परभूमि, and स्थ who stays.

n. (-णं)
Another's ornament.
m. (-णः)
Peace purchased by ceding the produce of lands.
E.
पर, and भूषण ornament.

m. (-भृत्)
A crow.
E.
पर another, (the cuckoo,) and भृत् who nourishes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cherished or nourished by a stranger, fostered, adopted.
m. (-तः)
The Indian cuckoo, which is supposed to leave its eggs in the nest of the crow to be hatched.
E.
पर another, and भृत nourished.

n. (-तं)
A present, an offering.
E.
पर, भृत prepared, अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Destroying or subduing a foe.
E.
पर, and भेदक who breaks.

ind.
1 A particle of command.
2 Of dismissal or refusal.
3 Hereafter, afterwards.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Best, most excellent.
2 Chief, principal, preceding.
3 First.
ind. (-मं)
1 A term of assent, yes.
2 A term of command.
E.
पर best, मा to mete, aff. ड or डम्.

f. (-तिः)
1 Chief object or refuge, as a god, a protector.
2 Final felicity.
E.
परम, and गति going.

f. (-तिः)
Translation to heaven, final beatitude.
E.
परमा best, गति going.

mf. (-वः-वी)
An excellent bull or cow.
E.
परम, and गो a cow.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Very mysterious or profound.
E.
परम, and गहन thick.

n. (-तं)
A different opinion or doctrine.
E.
पर, and मत thought.

n. (-दं)
1 Eminence, high station.
2 Final felicity.
E.
परम, and पद station.

n. (-ह्म)
The Supreme Spirit.
E.
परम, and ब्रह्मन् the same.

m. (-जः)
A supreme monarch.
E.
परम, and राजन् a king, टच् aff.

m. (-र्षिः)
A Ṛṣi or divine sage, of a peculiar order or division, comprising the Muni BHELA and others.
E.
परम excellent, and ऋषि a divine sage.

m. (-ज्ञः)
One who knows another's character or disposition.
E.
पर, and मर्म्म a vital point, and ज्ञ who knows.

m. (-र्म्मा)
A virtuous or pious man, one who attends scrupulously to the proper duties of his tribe or station.
E.
परम best, स्व own, धर्म्म virtue or duty, and अनिच् added.

m. (-सः)
An ascetic, a religious man who has subdued all his senses by abstract meditation.
E.
परम best or first, हंस devotee.

f. (-ना)
A beautiful woman.
E.
परम, and अङ्गना a woman.

m. (-णुः)
1 An atom, the invisible base of all aggregate bodies; thirty of them are supposed to form a note in a sunbeam; the lowest measure of weight; in Logic, six of them form the first perceptible object.
2 A measure of time, the sun's passage past an atom of matter.
E.
परम first, and अणु an atom.

m. (-कः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
परमाणु an atom, अङ्ग the body, कप् aff., deriv. irr.; smaller than the smallest; as he is larger than the largest, &c.

m. (-त्मा)
The Supreme Being, considered as the soul of the universe.
E.
परम first, आत्मन् spirit or soul.

n. (-तं)
Pure unitarianism.
m. (-तः)
VIṢṆU, the only supreme.
E.
परम, and अद्वैत without duality.

n. (-न्न)
An oblation of rice to progenitors or gods, boiled with milk and sugar.
E.
परम best, and अन्न boiled rice; or परम the best, the supreme, (deities, &c.) and अन्न food.

m. (-मः)
1 The inclination of a planet's orbit to the ecliptic.
2 The sine of the sun's greatest declination.
E.
परम, and अपम declination.

m. (-षः)
A particular tree: see असन.

m. (-युः)
The longest period of life, either in men or animals.
E.
परम, and आयुस् life.

m. (-र्थः)
1 Truth, fitness.
2 Spiritual knowledge.
3 Any excellent or important aim or object.
4 The best sense.
5 The best kind of wealth.
E.
परम, and अर्थ object.

m. (-वित्)
A sage, a philosopher, one who knows the truth.
E.
परमार्थ, and विद who knows.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
Who or what acquires knowledge of truth, the best kind of wealth, &c.
E.
परमार्थ, and विद् to acquire, श aff. and नुम् augment.

f. (-धिः)
Utmost term or limit.
E.
परम, and अवधि limit.

m. (-तः)
A king and holy saint, apparently the same as ŚĀLIVĀHANA.
E.
परम excellent, अर्हत a Jina.

m. (-त्युः)
A crow.
E.
पर another, and मृत्यु death; having many enemies.

m. (-रः)
1 The Supreme

Being.
2
Ś

IVA.
3

VIṢṆU.
f. (-री)
DURGĀ.
E.
परम best, ईश्वर lord.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Supreme, superior.
m. (-ष्ठः)
1

BRAHMĀ.
2

A deity.
E.
परमे, and स्थ who stays or is.

m. (-ष्ठी)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2

A Jina or deified teacher of the Jaina sect.
3 A kind of Śālagrāma stone.
4 A Guru or spiritual guide.
E.
परमे in the most exalted place, in heaven, स्था to be, Uṇādi aff. निन्.

n. (-दं)
1 Eternal felicity.
2 The abode of VIṢṆU.
E.
पर् another, पद degree.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Successive, proceeding from one to another, from father to son, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 A sort of deer.
2 A great-great-grandson.
f. (-रा)
1 Race, progeny, lineage.
2 Order, method, continuous arrangement, regular series or succession.
E.
पर subsequent, repeated, and the nasal augment.

ind.
Mutually.
E.
परम्पर and तसि aff.

n. (-कं)
Immolating animals in sacrifice.
E.
परम्पर traditionary or successive, and अक going or worshipping; or पर much, पर the best, and अक going, custom.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Hereditary, what has come by inheritance or descent.
2 Traditional.
E.
परं another, and पर again, another, ख aff.

m. (-रुः)
A potherb, (Eclipta prostrata); also केशराज.
E.
पर much, रुह to grow, डु aff.

m. (-रुः)
A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia.)
E.
वृ to fill or satisfy, आरु aff.

n. (-कं)
Heaven, paradise.
E.
पर another, and लोक world.

m. (-मः)
Death, dying.
E.
पर another, लोक world, and गम going.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Dependant, subject.
E.
पर another, मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Subservient, dependant, subject.
3 Deceived.
E.
पर another, and वश subjection.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
Reprehensible, blamable.
n. (-च्यं)
Fault, defect.
E.
पर, and वाच्य to be named, not to be spoken of.

m. (-णिः)
1 A judge, a ruler.
2 A year.
3 The peacock on which the god KĀRTTIKEYA rides.
E.
पर best, वा to go, णि aff.

m. (-तः)
A name of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA.
E.
पर best, व्रत religious observance.

n. (-शं)
A kind of gem.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Fit or proper for a hatchet.
E.
परश an axe, यञ् aff.

m. (-शुः)
An axe, a hatchet.
E.
पर another, शु to injure, Uṇādi aff. कु.

mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु)
Dead, expired.
E.
पर away, remote, असु vital breath.

m. (-रः)
1 A soldier armed with an axe.
2 A name of GAṆ

EŚA.
3

PARAŚURĀMA: see the next.
E.
परशु an axe, धर who holds.

m. (-मः)
A hero and demigod; the first of the three RĀMAS, and the sixth Avatāra or descent of the deity VIṢṆU; who appeared in the world as the son of the saint JAMADAGNI, for the purpose of repressing the tyranny and punishing the violence of the Kṣatriya, or military tribe; PARAŚURĀMA appears to typify the tribe of Brahmans and their contests with the Kṣetriyas.
E.
परशु an axe, and राम who delights in; also with कन् added, परशुरामक; and with the first member, पर्शु, पर्शुराम, q. v.

m. (-धः)
An axe, a hatchet.
E.
पर another, an enemy, श्व derived from श्वि to grow or thrive, परश्व the prosperity of a foe, घे to drink, क aff.; what drinks the blood or destroys the life of an enemy; also पारश्वध and परस्वध.

m. (-धः)
An axe: see परश्वध.

m. (-घः)
One armed with an axe, a hatchet-man, a pioneer, &c.
E.
परश्वध an axe, aff. अण्.

ind.
The day after to-morrow.
E.
पर after, श्वस् to-morrow; also परःश्वम्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Associated with another.
2 Fighting or engaged with another.
E.
पर, and सङ्गत gone with.

m. (-कः)
The soul.
E.
पर best, संज्ञा name or title, aff. कन्.

m. (-न्धः)
Relation or connexion with another.
E.
पर, and सम्वन्ध connexion.

mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि)
1 Related to another.
2 Belonging to another.
E.
परसम्वन्ध, and इनि aff.

ind.
1 Subsequently, afterwards.
2 Behind.
E.
पर, and अस्तातिल् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Mutual, interchanging.
E.
पर another, repeated; from one to another.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A friend, an intimate.
E.
परस्पर, and ज्ञ who knows.

f. (-तिः)
Mutual concurrence or assent.
E.
परस्पर, and अनुमति agreement.

ind.
Mutually.
E.
परस्पर, and आम् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Mutual assistance.
2 Offensive and defensive alliance.
E.
परस्पर, and उपकार aid.

m. (-री)
1 An ally.
2 An associate, a helper.
E.
इनि added to the last.

n. (-दं)
The transitive or active verb.
E.
परस्मै to another, पद an inflected word.

n. (-स्वं)
Another person's property.
E.
पर, and स्व own.

n. (-त्वं)
Another's right.
E.
पर, and स्वत्व own right.

n. (-नं)
Conferring a right upon another as by gift, &c.
E.
परस्वत्व, and आपादन producing.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Extortionary, extortioner.
E.
परस्व, and आदायिन् taking.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Dependant, living on the property of others.
E.
परस्व, and उपजीविक subsisting.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Friendly, benevolent.
2 Good or profitable for another.
E.
पर, and हित favourable.

ind.
Crooked, crookedly.
